title: Jump Game III
summary: Given an array of non-negative integers, starting from the initial index, you can jump forward or backward by the value at the current index.
statement: Given an array of non-negative integers, starting from the initial index, you can jump forward or backward by the value at the current index. Determine if you can reach an index with a value of 0 without jumping outside the array.
constraints: From index i jump exactly arr[i] positions left or right.
Return whether any reachable index contains zero.
hints: Treat indices as graph nodes with up to two outgoing jumps.
DFS or BFS from start and mark each visited index.
Return true on a zero; enqueue only in-range unseen destinations.
Graph search visits exactly the reachable indices and terminates despite cycles.
editorial: Graph search visits exactly the reachable indices and terminates despite cycles.

tests.explanation: Every route cycles without reaching index one.
